# Psalm 80 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. According-to-Lilies. A-testimony. Of-Asaph. A-psalm.

**2** O-Shepherd-of Israel give-ear, leader-of Joseph like-the-flock; enthroned-upon the-cherubim shine-forth.

**3** Before Ephraim and-Benjamin and-Manasseh stir-up your-might, and-come for-salvation for-us.

**4** O-God restore-us, and-cause-to-shine your-face, and-we-will-be-saved.

**5** O-YHWH God-of hosts, how-long have-you-smoked against-prayer-of your-people?

**6** You-have-fed-them bread-of tears, and-you-have-given-them-to-drink tears in-great-measure.

**7** You-make-us a-strife to-our-neighbors, and-our-enemies mock among-themselves.

**8** O-God-of hosts restore-us, and-cause-to-shine your-face, and-we-will-be-saved.

**9** A-vine from-Egypt you-uprooted; you-drove-out nations and-you-planted-it.

**10** You-cleared before-it, and-it-took-root its-roots, and-it-filled the-land.

**11** Were-covered mountains with-its-shadow, and-its-branches cedars-of God.

**12** It-sent-out its-boughs to the-sea, and-to the-River its-shoots.

**13** Why have-you-broken-down its-walls, and-pluck-it all passing-of the-way?

**14** Ravages-it the-boar from the-forest, and-creature-of the-field feeds-on-it.

**15** O-God-of hosts return please; look from-heaven and-see, and-visit this vine,

**16** And-the-stock which planted your-right-hand, and-upon the-son you-strengthened for-yourself.

**17** Burned with-fire, cut-down; at-rebuke-of your-face they-perish.

**18** Let-be your-hand upon the-man-of your-right-hand, upon the-son-of-man you-strengthened for-yourself.

**19** And-not we-will-turn-back from-you; revive-us and-on-your-name we-will-call.

**20** O-YHWH God-of hosts restore-us; cause-to-shine your-face and-we-will-be-saved.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **80:2**: 'Enthroned-upon the-cherubim' (yoshev hakkerubim) — Ark-of-the-Covenant imagery; God's throne is above the cherubim.

- **80:9-16**: Extended vine metaphor for Israel — uprooted from Egypt, planted in Canaan, grown to fill the land, now broken and burned.

- **80:16,18**: 'Son' (ben) — ambiguous: the vine-branch? The king? Messianic overtones in 'son-of-man you-strengthened.'

— EMET
